claims.answer: Desktop app (Tauri) for macOS and Windows; Linux builds exist in CI but are not in the v0.2.8 release assets; web UI only when run from source; no mobile app, CLI or editor extension.

browser.answer: The same React UI runs in a browser against the local server via pnpm dev:web from source; no released or hosted web client.

mobile_browser.answer: Server binds loopback and rejects non-loopback Host/Origin by default; non-loopback exposure is unauthenticated, so no supported phone browser path.

evidence.locator: Sections: Many sessions; Bots; Review; Worktrees and remote hosts; Agent cost; Install; Configuration; How it is built; Roadmap
evidence.finding: Terminal for many agent sessions with ACTIVE state tags, Bots and group chat with a lead, file/diff/browser pane views, per-pane SSH, usage dashboard, BYOK providers, loopback-only server, AGPL-3.0; roadmap lists reconnect, LocalPtyBackend and cloud as future.

evidence.title: Termany LICENSE
evidence.finding: AGPL-3.0 with a notice that a separate commercial licence is available from ThinkAny, LLC by contact.

evidence.title: Root package.json
evidence.finding: license "AGPL-3.0-only"; npm workspaces apps/* and packages/*; scripts dev:web, dev:desktop, bundle:server; no bin entry.

evidence.title: Tauri config
evidence.finding: Tauri 2 desktop shell, 1280x832 window, updater endpoint https://cdn.termany.sh/latest.json, bundle targets app and dmg.

evidence.title: Build and Release workflow
evidence.finding: Matrix macos-arm64/x64 (signed, notarized), windows-x64 (NSIS, unsigned) and linux-x64 (AppImage/deb, manual test build until its next public release).

evidence.title: Built-in agent registry
evidence.finding: Built-in agents claude, codex, openclaw (enabled) and gemini, grok, fastclaw, hermes, opencode, cursor (cursor-agent), kimi, omp (disabled by default); custom agents can be added with a command and args or an ACP HTTP endpoint.

evidence.title: Managed ACP bridges
evidence.finding: Ships @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp and codex-acp bridges that drive the user-installed claude/codex CLI.

evidence.title: Subscription-preserving credentials
evidence.finding: Strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY style variables from Bot conversations so Claude and Codex stay on the CLI login (subscription); terminal panes keep the user shell environment.

evidence.title: BYOK provider config
evidence.finding: Providers are user-added Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible endpoints with the user own key stored in local SQLite; no built-in managed provider.

evidence.title: Local model gateway
evidence.finding: Local gateway at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/gateway lets agent CLIs use a configured BYOK provider through protocol translation; routes use per-route bearer tokens.

evidence.title: Request guard
evidence.finding: Server binds 127.0.0.1 by default, rejects unknown Origin and non-loopback Host; TERMANY_HOST can expose it with no authentication (README warning).

evidence.title: Server HTTP and WebSocket routes
evidence.finding: REST routes for state, activity, agents, ACP chat/permission, SSH, fs, git, usage, system stats; detached PTYs kept for 7 days (TERMANY_DETACH_TTL_MS); no issue, schedule or user-account routes.

evidence.title: Local SQLite store
evidence.finding: Single ~/.termany/termany.db with workspace, app_meta, session_cwd, session_scroll, session_screen tables; scroll history capped at 40 sessions.

evidence.title: Agent activity tracker
evidence.finding: Server-owned working/done/needs-attention state derived from foreground job and screen content; epoch-checked report and ack routes; SSE snapshots.

evidence.title: Git overview and diffs
evidence.finding: Read-only git calls: rev-parse, worktree list, status, diff, merge-base; no commit, push, branch creation, worktree add or PR operations.

evidence.title: Agent session history readers
evidence.finding: Reads Claude (~/.claude/projects) and Codex (~/.codex/sessions) transcripts for history and token usage; other agents unsupported.

evidence.title: SSH profiles and tests
evidence.finding: Per-pane SSH profiles (host, user, port, password or identity file) with connection test; runs through local OpenSSH.

evidence.title: SSH port forwarding
evidence.finding: One-click loopback SSH forward for ports served on a remote pane.

evidence.title: Agent usage dashboard
evidence.finding: Estimated dollar cost from a built-in $/MTok price table over transcript tokens; unpriced models counted as unpriced tokens.

evidence.title: Group chat and lead dispatch
evidence.finding: Group chats of Bots: a lead member is asked for a JSON dispatch decision (none, single, parallel, sequential), members reply in separate sessions, @ mentions route, max 24 turns, 90 s member inactivity timeout.

evidence.title: Group decision failover
evidence.finding: 30 s decision timeout with up to 3 attempts and failover to another member as leader.

evidence.title: Skill discovery and Bot binding
evidence.finding: Discovers ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude/skills and Codex skills; GitHub import into ~/.termany/skills; prompts carry skill names and absolute SKILL.md paths.
